Jodha Andaaz Choker Set- Mint Green

MOQ: 50 pcs
Enquire on WhatsApp

Part of the timeless Jodha Collection, the Jodha Andaaz Choker Set reflects royal elegance and refined craftsmanship. Designed with intricately set Kundan motifs and finished with delicate pearl drops, this piece brings together heritage beauty and contemporary grace. The choker sits comfortably along the neckline, making it ideal for weddings, festive occasions, and intimate celebrations. Paired with matching earrings, it adds a soft glow and regal charm to both traditional and fusion outfits. Available in four elegant colour variants, green, red, pink, and mint green, each shade is curated to complement a wide range of styles and skin tones. A statement of understated luxury, this set is perfect for those who appreciate classic design with a modern soul.
